notes.title: Early access 1.7.0
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Now the map is decorate on the theme of Halloween !
	[*]Adding ritual items to fit the Halloween theme.
	[*]Brand new jumpscare.
	[*]Added an interior lighting system that runs on a gasoline generator.
	[*]New music on the menu/lobby.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Many adjustments to the sfx and weather.
[/list]

notes.title: Early access 1.6.0
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Adding rain and thunder
	[*]Added a new UI in the lobby
	[*]The selection of characters has been completely redone
	[*]The Christmas decorations have been removed
	[*]The visual of the game has been reworked
[/list]

notes.title: Early access 1.5.1
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Fixed a problem where the monster would not attack if the player was crouching.
	[*]Fixed several minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Early access 1.5.0
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Christmas is here!!! The map was decorated as well as the lobby and the main menu.
	[*]New item for the renegade allowing to kill an exorcist down. 
	[*]New guide to explain the game mode in the lobby.
	[*]New endgame screen with several new information in it.
	[*]The demon now has a new style of movement after a while.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Fixed a problem when a player is roped up.
[/list]

notes.title: Early access 1.4.0
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
	[*]When the renegade is dead, he can now use specific abilities.
	[*]When the player is dead, he can now interact with some objects to make them move.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The demon no longer spawns next to a player.
	[*]The demon no longer attacks when it hears a player above or below it.
	[*]The defeat and victory system has been completely fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Early access 1.3.0
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
	[*]When the renegade uses his attitude n°1 (the call of the demon), during the whole hunt the demon does not attack the renegade anymore 
	[*]Each time the demon appears, the lamp flashes for 2 seconds. (If the demon appears via the renegade's ability, the lamp will not flash).
	[*]New image of the ability n°1
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Reduced television sound
	[*]Removal of particles when the demon appears via the renegade's ability
[/list]

notes.title: Early access 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Now the map is decorate on the theme of Halloween !
	[*]There are also some changes for the Halloween theme in the game !
	[*]Added a new test feature, you now have the possibility to push your friend in the game by pressing your right click mouse.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Rectification for some untranslated text
[/list]

notes.title: Early access 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
	[*]We have completely changed the demon thanks to your feedback now it appears and is not there all the time 
	[*]Added a screamer (This is a first version and we plan to improve it as soon as possible)	
	[*]The renegade menu is now on the screen all the time
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Fixed a problem with doors and rope
	[*]Fixed a problem when the player dies
	[*]Fixed a problem where the demon could get stuck
[/list]

notes.title: Early access 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]	Add a lot of country in parameter game
[*]	Added effect when the demon is close to you
[*]	Added an information message in the lobby
[*]	Added voice chat in the lobby
[*]	Add information about the keys already found in the inventory menu
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]	Fixed most of the problems at game launch
[*]	Fixed a performance problem when launching the tutorial video
[*]	Fixed a problem with the flashlight 
[*]	Correction the renegade is now available only from 3 players
[*]	Rectification for some untranslated text
[/list]

notes.title: Early access 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added pages throughout the map to explain the history of the house
[*] Added more general indication in the game
[*] Add a video tutorial
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Correction of a problem with the push to talk
[*] Fixed a double light problem in game
[*] Fixed demonic mark
[*] Rectification for some untranslated text
[/list]
